headline: The precedence of operators within expressions should be made explicit
description: Parentheses shall be used to avoid any potential ambiguity in operator evaluation order when combining bitwise, arithmetic, and logical operators.
automotive_rationale: In ECU communication protocols (e.g., CAN, LIN, FlexRay), frame deserialization combines bitwise shifts (<<, >>) and bitwise OR (|). Without explicit parentheses, operator precedence misunderstanding can cause critical signal misinterpretation (e.g., throttle angle or battery cell voltage).
asil_level_impact: ASIL-B to ASIL-D (Corrupted sensor signal decoding causing unintended acceleration or false BMS emergency contactor trip).
non_compliant_example: uint16_t raw_voltage = payload[0] << 8 + payload[1]; /* '+' has higher precedence than '<<' */
approved_deviation_criteria: Allowed only when using purely unary operators or simple assignment chains where compiler warnings confirm zero precedence ambiguity.

headline: The memory allocation and deallocation functions of <stdlib.h> shall not be used
description: Functions malloc, calloc, realloc, and free shall not be used in safety-critical embedded systems.
automotive_rationale: Dynamic heap allocation introduces non-deterministic execution timing, memory fragmentation, and risk of allocation failure at runtime. In automotive ECUs (e.g., Brake Control, Steering, Battery Management), memory starvation can cause catastrophic unrecoverable faults.
asil_level_impact: ASIL-D (Mandatory static memory allocation. Dynamic heap strictly prohibited per ISO 26262-6 Table 2).
cwe_mapping: CWE-401 (Missing Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime), CWE-789 (Memory Allocation with Excessive Size Value)
compliant_example: static BmsCellData_t cell_buffer[MAX_CELLS_COUNT]; /* Static deterministic buffer */
approved_deviation_criteria: Strictly no deviation allowed in ASIL-C/D systems. For ASIL-A/QM, permitted only during one-time ECU power-on initialization before RTOS scheduler start.

headline: The value returned by a function having non-void return type shall be used
description: Any function returning a status or error code must have its return value evaluated by the caller, or explicitly cast to void if deliberately ignored.
automotive_rationale: In ECU device drivers (CAN transceivers, SPI Flash, ADC converters), functions return status codes indicating hardware bus timeouts, parity errors, or buffer overflows. Ignoring return values leads to silent system failure.
asil_level_impact: ASIL-C / ASIL-D (Ignoring hardware bus faults leads to undetected failure modes violating functional safety targets).
approved_deviation_criteria: Casting return value explicitly to (void) is acceptable only if the function documentation confirms that failure has no safety impact (e.g. debug UART print in QM builds).

headline: Every switch statement shall have a default label
description: All switch statements must include a default clause that terminates in either a break statement, return statement, or error handling mechanism.
automotive_rationale: Defensive programming in ISO 26262 requires handling unexpected states caused by electromagnetic interference (EMI), memory bit-flips, or unhandled enum states in state machines.
asil_level_impact: ASIL-B to ASIL-D (State machine desynchronization; failure to handle corrupt state variable).
cwe_mapping: CWE-478 (Missing Default Case in Switch Statement)
approved_deviation_criteria: No deviation permitted. A default clause must exist and perform safe-state transition.

headline: A conversion should not be performed between a pointer to object and an integer type
description: Casting an object pointer to an integer or vice-versa creates implementation-dependent behavior and memory alignment faults.
automotive_rationale: Memory-mapped I/O in microcontrollers requires accessing peripheral hardware registers at fixed 32-bit addresses. However, uncontrolled casting can cause unaligned bus accesses and hard fault exceptions in 32-bit ARM Cortex-M/R cores.
asil_level_impact: ASIL-B to ASIL-D (Microcontroller hardware HardFault exception leading to unexpected ECU reset).
compliant_example: #define CAN0_BASE_ADDR ((volatile CanHardwareRegs_t *)0x40024000UL) /* Encapsulated in validated BSP header */
non_compliant_example:
uint32_t reg_addr = 0x40024000;
*((volatile uint32_t *)reg_addr) = 0x01; /* Ad-hoc integer to pointer cast in application code */
approved_deviation_criteria: Permitted only within microcontroller abstraction layers (MCAL) and Board Support Packages (BSP) inside designated register map header files.

headline: A pointer resulting from arithmetic on a pointer operand shall address an element of the same array
description: Array indexing and pointer arithmetic must be bounded within the array dimension plus one beyond the end.
automotive_rationale: Out-of-bounds memory accesses in ECU RAM corrupt critical global variables, calibration parameters (EEPROM mirror), or RTOS task stack frames, leading to arbitrary memory corruption.
asil_level_impact: ASIL-D (Corrupts safety-critical calibration variables or trigger stack smash).
cwe_mapping: CWE-120 (Buffer Overflow), CWE-129 (Improper Validation of Array Index)
non_compliant_example: sensor_readings[sensor_idx] = Adc_Read(sensor_idx); /* sensor_idx is not boundary-checked against MAX_SENSOR_CHANNELS */
approved_deviation_criteria: No deviation permitted. All array indices must be proven bounded through static asserts or runtime range guards.

headline: A compatible declaration shall be visible when an object or function with external linkage is defined
description: All global variables and externally visible functions must be declared in an associated header file before definition.
automotive_rationale: Ensures strong type consistency across AUTOSAR software components (SWCs) and Basic Software (BSW). Prevents conflicting type definitions across translation units.
asil_level_impact: ASIL-B (Mismatched type definitions across ECU modules causing silent data corruption).
non_compliant_example:
/* In throttle_driver.c without header declaration */
uint16_t g_throttle_raw_position = 0U;
approved_deviation_criteria: Static local variables with static linkage do not require header declarations.

headline: There shall be no dead code
description: Any operation whose execution does not affect the program output or observable behavior is considered dead code and must be removed.
automotive_rationale: Dead code confuses safety reviewers, wastes ROM memory in constrained automotive microcontrollers, and may indicate incomplete defect remediation or legacy testing stubs.
asil_level_impact: ASIL-A to ASIL-D (Required by ISO 26262-6 Clause 9 for code structural coverage and verification).
compliant_example: /* Redundant unused test branches removed from production ECU build */
non_compliant_example: uint32_t temp = CalculateOffset(); /* temp is never read or used subsequently */
approved_deviation_criteria: Defensive default cases or assertions inserted specifically for functional safety traps are permitted if documented.

headline: Controlling expressions shall not be invariant
description: An expression controlling an if statement, while loop, or for loop shall not evaluate to the same constant value on all execution paths.
automotive_rationale: Invariant conditions indicate logic errors, copy-paste defects, or unreachable safety protection logic in automotive control loops.
asil_level_impact: ASIL-C / ASIL-D (Safety guard condition always evaluates true or false, rendering emergency shutdown ineffective).
cwe_mapping: CWE-571 (Expression is Always True), CWE-570 (Expression is Always False)
approved_deviation_criteria: Allowed for standard do { ... } while (0) macro wrappers.

headline: The value of an object with automatic storage duration shall not be read before being set
description: All local automatic variables must be explicitly initialized before being read or used in calculations.
automotive_rationale: Reading uninitialized stack variables causes non-deterministic behavior, reading residual values from previous stack frames, and random control logic triggering.
asil_level_impact: ASIL-D (Severe: Non-deterministic ECU calculations leading to unpredictable actuator actuation).
compliant_example:
uint32_t checksum = 0U;
for (uint8_t i = 0U; i < len; i++) { checksum += buf[i]; }
non_compliant_example:
uint32_t checksum;
for (uint8_t i = 0U; i < len; i++) { checksum += buf[i]; } /* checksum contains random stack garbage */
approved_deviation_criteria: Strictly no deviation allowed. Mandatory rule.
